value.rationale: The motivating paper explicitly leaves strong localization in prescribed weakly linked components as a structural question. This gives a complete design rule for the minimal nontrivial multi-community path: precisely which masses and bridge cuts admit asymptotically near-unit end concentration, when exact resonances are possible, when incommensurate frequencies provide arbitrarily good but never exact concentration, and which asymmetric structures necessarily leak. Pell witnesses quantify high-fidelity readout rather than supplying an arbitrary numerical case.
